name: pickuppatrol-mcp
description: Read and change your children's school dismissal plans in PickUp Patrol — defaults, day-by-day changes and school cutoff times

username.title: PickUp Patrol email
username.description: The email address you sign in to app.pickuppatrol.net with.

password.title: PickUp Patrol password
password.description: Your PickUp Patrol password. Stored by the host, never logged by this server.

tools.name: pup_get_session
tools.description: The signed-in parent account and the students linked to it

tools.name: pup_list_students
tools.description: Every student on the account with their weekly default plans

tools.name: pup_get_student
tools.description: One student, including their default plan for each weekday

tools.name: pup_get_default_plans
tools.description: A student's weekly default dismissal plan, day by day

tools.name: pup_list_plans
tools.description: Day-by-day dismissal plans over a date range

tools.name: pup_get_plan
tools.description: The dismissal plan for one student on one date

tools.name: pup_list_transportations
tools.description: The dismissal options a school offers, with their rules

tools.name: pup_get_school
tools.description: School profile, notify times and per-day plan cutoff times

tools.name: pup_list_non_school_days
tools.description: Dates a plan cannot be set for, and dates that already differ from the default

tools.name: pup_set_plan
tools.description: Change or clear the dismissal plan for one or more dates

tools.name: pup_set_default_plans
tools.description: Change a student's weekly default dismissal plan

tools.name: pup_mark_defaults_reviewed
tools.description: Mark a student's default plans as reviewed

tools.name: pup_healthcheck
tools.description: Verify credentials and that the PickUp Patrol API is reachable
